findings.evidence: Sibling nonempty-of-intersection names in this same family list operands in statement order and use juxtaposition for application: `Crosscut/Endpoints.lean:310 nonempty_frontier_ball_inter_closure_ball_inter_sphere : (frontier (ball c r) ∩ closure (ball c r ∩ sphere ζ ρ)).Nonempty` (`frontier_ball` = `frontier (ball …)`), `Crosscut/Image.lean:352 nonempty_frontier_inter_closure_image_inter_sphere`, `Analysis/Normed/Module/Ball/Cut.lean:157 nonempty_ball_inter_ball`. Mathlib likewise: `Mathlib/Topology/JacobsonSpace.lean:107 nonempty_inter_closedPoints`, `Mathlib/MeasureTheory/Measure/Support.lean:206 nonempty_inter_support_of_pos`.
findings.fix: Name the intersections in statement order, e.g. `nonempty_image_inter_ball_inter_filledHull_or_image_sdiff_closedBall_inter_filledHull`, so `filledHull` is not adjacent to a set descriptor it is not applied to.
findings.issue: In `nonempty_inter_filledHull_image_inter_ball_or_image_sdiff_closedBall` the juxtaposition `filledHull_image_inter_ball` reads as the function applied to the following set, i.e. `filledHull (f '' (U ∩ ball ζ ρ))`, whereas the statement is `(f '' (U ∩ ball ζ ρ) ∩ filledHull K).Nonempty ∨ (f '' (U \ closedBall ζ ρ) ∩ filledHull K).Nonempty`; the hull is of `K`, which the name never mentions, and the operands of `∩` are given in reverse order.

summary: All new names describe their conclusions in standard terminology and no notation is added; the one defect is `nonempty_inter_filledHull_image_inter_ball_or_image_sdiff_closedBall`, whose token order reads as `filledHull (f '' (U ∩ ball ζ ρ))` rather than `f '' (U ∩ ball ζ ρ) ∩ filledHull K`.
